correction.reason: GeckoTerminal hourly reads were timing out or returning 429, so the nightly rows kept DexScreener rolling h24. This recount uses the nightly writer with retry, exponential backoff, jitter, and a 2.1s pace. No pool on this day exhausted those retries. A pool keeps rolling h24 when Gecko returns 404 or the hourly series does not cover the America/New_York day, and that pool is listed on dexscreenerH24Fallbacks. dexCombined24hUsd is one DexScreener h24 sample taken for this recount and shared across 2026-10-15 through 2026-10-18, not each night's sample.
